_README: KAMO rating prompt — live configuration, read by kamo-app/storeReview.js. Edit, commit,
push: GitHub Pages serves it in a couple of minutes and every device picks it up on its
NEXT launch. No build, no App Store review.
✅ LIVE SINCE 1.1.0. This file used to carry a warning that it was inert, and that warning
outlived the condition: the reader landed in kamo-app a075a4d, 1.1.0 shipped it on
2026-08-10 and 1.1.1 is what the App Store serves today. Editing this file changes what
real devices do. The warning is removed rather than softened — a note saying a control is
decoration is exactly what stops anyone reaching for the one lever that works without a
two-week review.
WHY THIS FILE EXISTS. August, rate_app_ask_outcome: 533 attempts, 452 of them dead on
`not_eligible_yet` (85%), 43 inside the cooldown, 17 with StoreReview unavailable, 12
below the score floor, 5 declined — and 4 people, total, ever reached Apple's sheet. The
data named the wrong number within a day. Fixing it needed a build and a review, which at
the time meant a fortnight. Ratings are the binding ASO constraint across this portfolio,
so a tuning loop measured in weeks is not a tuning loop.
finishesBeforeAsk WAS 2 and is the reason for most of those 452. It gates the 'retake'
trigger — the volume one, fired when someone finishes a hide and starts another. At 2 it
wanted a THIRD hide before the second could ask. 1 asks on the second, which is still a
repeat: they finished one and came back for more. Nothing else about the moment changes.
sharesBeforeAsk stays 1 — already the floor. Note its trigger only fires on a CONFIRMED
share or camera-roll write, and the write was throwing on a missing Photos permission
until the same build that reads this file. Expect this path to wake up on its own.
maxHardAsks cannot exceed 3: that is Apple's own limit on requestReview() per 365 days.
A larger number here would not ask more, it would only make the analytics lie.
minScore is the hidden-% below which we never ask — someone who botched the camouflage is
being asked to rate their own failure, and that buys 3-star reviews.
enabled:false is the kill switch: no soft-ask, no sheet, nothing spent.
minDaysBetweenAsks WENT 30 -> 14 ON 2026-08-14, AND IT IS THE ONLY VALUE CHANGED.
Week of 08-10, uniques by outcome: skipped_within_30d_cooldown 222, not_eligible_yet 84,
skipped_low_score 61, skipped_already_asked_this_install 35 (an older binary's name). The
cooldown is now the single biggest thing standing between this app and a rating — bigger
than the eligibility gate that was fixed last week.
30 days was borrowed caution. It costs nothing to be careful with APPLE's allowance, and
this is not Apple's allowance: the soft-ask is our own Alert and spends nothing against
the 3-per-365 cap, which only requestReview() touches. maxSoftAsks 5 is the real ceiling
on how often one person can be bothered, and it is untouched.
What made 30 wrong is retention. D1 across this portfolio runs 2-9%; a user asked on day
0 and told to come back on day 30 is, in practice, never asked again. 14 keeps a floor
that a person would recognise as polite while landing inside the window where KAMO users
still exist. It is not a guess about the right number, it is a halving — the smallest
move that produces a readable answer.
⚠️ WHAT THIS DOES NOT FIX, AND DO NOT LET IT LOOK LIKE IT DID. Over 14 days,
shown_and_opted_in reached 173 unique users, skipped_storereview_unavailable only 10 —
so requestReview() really is being called, on real App Store builds, ~173 times. The
store shows 9 ratings. That gap is not explained by anything in this file, and raising
the number of asks cannot explain it either. Candidates: people dismissing Apple's sheet,
the 3-per-365 cap being counted per Apple ID rather than per install, or the store's
rating count simply lagging. Settling it takes one live device and twenty minutes, and
until it is settled every number below is being tuned in the dark.
Anything invalid is ignored field by field and falls back to what shipped in the binary,
so a typo costs you that one value, never the feature.
body: A quick rating really helps KAMO grow 💚
